FIJ reports that VitalReg is the digital birth registration recently launched by Nigeria's National Population Commission, where a Lagos man found a birth registered in February under his name.

The Federal Ministry of Information reports Akwa Ibom State announced commencement of the electronic civil registration and vital statistics (e-CRVS) system for digital registration of births and deaths, replicating the NPC chairman's 15 July 2026 national briefing, with NPC asking the state to support full roll-out.
